name: OllamaConnector
label: Ollama Connector
description: Invokes Ollama models (Generate or Chat mode) via its local REST API and returns the response.

fields.name: BaseUrl
fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: The Ollama server base URL (default: http://localhost:11434).

fields.name: Model
fields.label: Model
fields.description: The Ollama model to use (e.g., llama2, mistral, codellama). Must be pulled into Ollama first.

fields.name: Prompt
fields.label: Prompt
fields.description: The text prompt for Generate mode or extra user message in Chat mode.

fields.name: Mode
fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Choose whether to run Generate (/api/generate) or Chat (/api/chat).

fields.name: ChatMessages
fields.label: Chat Messages
fields.description: Optional: Chat messages when in Chat mode. Format each as role:content (e.g., 'user:hello').

fields.name: Headers
fields.label: Headers
fields.description: Optional: Extra HTTP headers for the request.

fields.name: OllamaResult
fields.label: Ollama Result
fields.description: The final text response returned by Ollama.

fields.name: ResponseCode
fields.label: Response Code
fields.description: The HTTP status code returned by Ollama API.
